question:
Simplify the following.

cot 13° cot 27° cot 45° cot 63° cot 77° = ?
solution:
Given:

cot 13° cot 27° cot 45° cot 63° cot 77°

Formulas used:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e073e32ec4277aef5655b4d655ab3a661e66eccec51056b97671ba3a40e241b9.png] 

Calculation:

cot 13° cot 27° cot 45° cot 63° cot 77°

⇒ cot 13° × cot 27° × cot 45° × cot (90° - 27°) × cot (90° - 13°)

⇒ cot 13° × cot 27° × cot 45° × tan13° × tan 27°

⇒ 1 × 1 × 1 = 1

∴ The required result is 1.
